{"parentUuid":"a38540a1-aa6a-4aa2-abd5-ea3efca94cfb","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"612ebaa5-9009-492f-be07-d0c10cc0630b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":"<bash-stdout>title:\tT03: Publish an update to the live site\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tMaysG-creator\nlabels:\tready-for-agent, ticket\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t4\n--\n## Parent\n\nSpec: #1\n\n## What to build\n\nThe admin can publish and unpublish an update, and `cms publish` renders only published updates into a static site: a home page listing updates newest first with a last-updated date, a purple and white CSS-only banner header, and relative paths only. `cms deploy` pushes the result to GitHub Pages, so a fan can open the live site and see the published update. A short runbook explains publish and deploy for whoever holds the admin role. This is the thin end-to-end path from write to live.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] The admin can publish a draft and unpublish a published update, and the status persists across a server restart\n- [ ] `cms publish` exports only published updates; drafts and unpublished updates never appear in the exported files\n- [ ] Re-running `cms publish` after an unpublish removes that update from the exported site\n- [ ] The exported home page lists published updates newest first, each with its last-updated date\n- [ ] The exported site contains no root-absolute paths in href or src attributes, and all internal links resolve\n- [ ] Update bodies in the export are sanitized, so a script tag and an onerror attribute do not execute\n- [ ] The public site uses the purple and white look with a banner header and has no sideways scrolling at 390 px\n- [ ] After `cms deploy`, the Pages URL over HTTPS shows at least one published update\n- [ ] A short runbook describes publish and deploy step by step\n- [ ] Publish and unpublish are POST forms with CSRF tokens\n\n## Blocked by\n\n- #3 (T02: Admin writes update drafts)</bash-stdout><bash-stderr></bash-stderr>"},"uuid":"29ca26aa-fe22-4978-b630-842ce009952a","timestamp":"2026-10-13T03:19:50.108Z","turnOrigin":"human","turnPosition":{"promptIndex":5,"turnIndex":7},"userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"372895ba-7bc1-4e96-8812-d1fa817c6645","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"34de7c2a-971c-4ce9-bfa3-5a134d1fa048","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyWz6VhgD4B36KQwcuMA","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01SJMtc9x4g88991cEMhHYzJ","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maysg-orca-iphs400-mp2-cms/372895ba-7bc1-4e96-8812-d1fa817c6645/scratchpad; cat > $S/comment.md <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings and resolutions\n\nThe review ran on two axes in parallel: **Standards** (CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md, plus a code-smell baseline) and **Spec** (this ticket and spec #1). It found no breaches of the hard constraints: paths are relative, only published content is exported, `site/` is rebuilt from scratch, bodies are sanitized, every form carries a CSRF token, and no dependency was added.\n\n| # | Axis | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Standards | No test that an editor is refused on `/publish` and `/unpublish` (SECURITY-CHECKLIST #4, #10) | **Fixed.** Added `test_editor_cannot_publish_or_unpublish`. Removing the admin check turns it red. |\n| 2 | Spec | \"status persists across a server restart\" was tested for publish only | **Fixed.** Added `test_admin_unpublishes_and_it_persists_across_a_restart`. |\n| 3 | Spec | Home page sorts by created date but shows the last-updated date, so dates can look out of order after an edit | **Kept by decision.** The order stays by when an update was first written, so a correction never jumps above newer news. {"parentUuid":"3626967f-d94d-423a-9f54-bf0b6b0628ff","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"89505f1c-d86b-4803-9f18-980353e1e523","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":"<bash-stdout>author:\tMaysG-creator\nassociation:\towner\nedited:\tfalse\nstatus:\tnone\n--\n## /code-review findings and resolutions\n\nThe review ran on two axes in parallel: **Standards** (CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md, plus a code-smell baseline) and **Spec** (this ticket and spec #1). It found no breaches of the hard constraints: paths are relative, only published content is exported, `site/` is rebuilt from scratch, bodies are sanitized, every form carries a CSRF token, and no dependency was added.\n\n| # | Axis | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Standards | No test that an editor is refused on `/publish` and `/unpublish` (SECURITY-CHECKLIST #4, #10) | **Fixed.** Added `test_editor_cannot_publish_or_unpublish`. Removing the admin check turns it red. |\n| 2 | Spec | \"status persists across a server restart\" was tested for publish only | **Fixed.** Added `test_admin_unpublishes_and_it_persists_across_a_restart`. |\n| 3 | Spec | Home page sorts by created date but shows the last-updated date, so dates can look out of order after an edit | **Kept by decision.** The order stays by when an update was first written, so a correction never jumps above newer news. Recorded in `CONTEXT.md` → Decisions; guarded by `test_editing_an_older_update_does_not_move_it_above_a_newer_one`. Sorting by `updated_at` turns that test red. |\n| 4 | Spec | Publishing left an old \"Last updated\" date on content that just went live | **Fixed.** Publishing now sets `updated_at`; `test_publishing_sets_the_last_updated_time`. |\n| 5 | Standards | Primitive Obsession: status strings passed around through `set_status(id, status)` | **Partly fixed.** Replaced with `updates.publish()` and `updates.unpublish()`. The status column itself is still a string; T04 (#5) reworks permissions and can revisit it. |\n| 6 | Standards | Duplicated Code: `updates/&lt;slug&gt;.html` built in two places; second Jinja environment | **Fixed.** One `update_path()` function and one environment, with the site title as a template global. |\n| 7 | Standards | Mysterious Name: Jinja filter `day`, test helper `set_status` | **Fixed.** Renamed to `local_date` and `post_status_form`. |\n| 8 | Standards | Test helpers imported from `test_t02_updates` | **Fixed.** `visible`, `create`, `save_new` moved to `tests/conftest.py`. |\n| 9 | Standards | Flash messages contained Markdown backticks that show literally | **Fixed.** |\n| 10 | Spec | Update page had a 390 px screenshot but no 1280 px one | **Fixed.** `docs/screenshots/t03_public-update_1280.png`. |\n| 11 | Standards | Feature Envy: `seed_demo.py` queries `users` directly | **Not changed.** Demo tooling only; worth moving into `app.users` when T07 (#8) adds user lookups. |\n| 12 | Spec | Scope: `GET /` on the admin server shows the live list, but its stylesheet and update links only resolve in `site/` | **Not changed.** It is a quick look at the home page; the full preview is `python3 -m http.server -d site`. |\n| 13 | Spec | Scope: seed adds sample updates; editors refused on publish ahead of T04 | **Kept.** Spec #1 \"Seed data\" asks for sample drafts and published items, all marked as sample with no scores. Refusing editors is the safe default; T04 adds the refused screen. |\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- Publish and unpublish persist across a server restart: tests for both directions.\n- Only published updates are exported, and a re-run drops unpublished ones: `test_export_holds_only_published_updates`, `test_republishing_after_an_unpublish_removes_the_update`.\n- Newest first with last-updated dates: `test_home_lists_published_updates_newest_first_with_last_updated_dates`, `test_each_update_page_shows_its_last_updated_date`.\n- Relative paths and resolving links: `test_export_uses_relative_paths_and_every_internal_link_resolves`.\n- Sanitized bodies: `test_exported_bodies_are_sanitized`.\n- Purple and white banner, no sideways scrolling at 390 px: `test_public_site_sets_a_mobile_viewport_and_a_css_only_banner`, plus screenshots `docs/screenshots/t03_*`. Checked by hand.\n- Live over HTTPS: https://maysg-creator.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/ lists the published sample update. Its home page, `style.css` and update page all return 200. Screenshot: `docs/screenshots/t03_live-home_1280.png`.\n- Runbook: `docs/runbooks/publish-and-deploy.md`.\n- POST forms with CSRF tokens: `test_publish_and_unpublish_are_post_forms_with_csrf_tokens`, `test_status_change_without_a_valid_csrf_token_is_rejected`.\n\nFull suite: 89 passed.\n\n--</bash-stdout><bash-stderr></bash-stderr>"},"uuid":"7a41d81b-8cdf-4e6d-ac28-4cb332c1b527","timestamp":"2026-10-13T03:23:24.760Z","turnOrigin":"human","turnPosition":{"promptIndex":10,"turnIndex":12},"userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"372895ba-7bc1-4e96-8812-d1fa817c6645","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}
